sourceFile: 18. BRS-161014  Report test new bond PT-8310M9S change bonding amount  17.2.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid evidence rows but misstates the main comparison and loses merged-condition grouping for tension rows.
issues: Primary factor should be PT-8310M9S bonding amount reduction, not normal bond versus all PT amounts.
Baseline should likely be PT-8310M9S at 0.5-0.6 mg, with reduced amounts as tests.
Normal bond 0930 appears to be reference/control context, not the main baseline.
Tension rows for Suspension D lack inherited bond and amount conditions.
Decision row is cited in context but not used to capture final conclusion.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as bonding amount reduction for new bond PT-8310M9S.
Set PT-8310M9S 0.5-0.6 mg as baseline and 0.4-0.5 mg, 0.3-0.4 mg as changed conditions.
Keep Normal bond 0930 as a reference subgroup or secondary comparator.
Propagate parent condition to Suspension D tension rows.
Add decision/conclusion evidence if row 40 or following rows contain judgement.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and are mostly sufficient, but grouping citations need corrected use of merged-row context.
